properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.enabled
properties.description: Enable runtime usage reporting and the bootusage endpoint.

properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.include-origins
properties.description: Include sanitized bean origin locations in the report.

properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.include-confidence
properties.description: Include heuristic confidence scoring in suggestions.

properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.detect-unused-jars
properties.description: Attempt best-effort detection of unused jars.

properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.markdown-summary
properties.description: Also write a Markdown summary to output-dir.

properties.name: spring.boot.usage.report.policies.fail-on-violation
properties.description: Fail startup on first policy violation (not enabled by default in this starter).
